name: Cookie Butter Swirl Latte
flavor_notes: Warm Biscoff cookie butter melted directly into hot espresso, poured over cold milk in a cookie butter-swirled glass.
barista_note: The richest and most decadent of the viral cookie butter coffees: melting warm cookie butter straight into the hot espresso concentrate creates an ultra-velvety speculoos syrup that marbles beautifully as it cascades over iced milk.

variations.title: Sofia's Homemade Cloud Foam
variations.twist: Whips softened Biscoff with heavy cream and milk into an airy cold foam cloud poured over iced vanilla espresso.

variations.title: Lacey's Quick Creamer Hack
variations.twist: Uses Chobani Cookie Butter creamer and brown sugar with a Biscoff-coated rim for a 2-minute cafe copycat.

preparations.tested_with: Counter Culture Big Trouble or George Howell Alchemy
preparations.roast_note: Rich milk chocolate and nutty notes amplify the melted speculoos spices.

ingredients.item: Cometeer capsule, melted and gently warmed
Speculoos / Lotus Biscoff cookie butter (for espresso melt)
Speculoos / Lotus Biscoff cookie butter (for cup swirl)
cold whole milk or oat milk

steps: Warm 1 tbsp cookie butter for 10 seconds and drizzle around the inside walls of your glass.
Fill the glass with ice and add 6 oz cold milk.
Warm the melted Cometeer extract slightly, then whisk in 1 tbsp cookie butter until glossy and fully dissolved.
Pour the cookie butter coffee extract over the iced milk and garnish with crushed cookie crumbs.

preparations.roast_note: Toasted wood and cereal notes in Chiaro harmonize perfectly with melted cookie butter.

ingredients.item: Nespresso Vertuo Double Espresso pod (Chiaro or Dolce)
Speculoos / Lotus Biscoff cookie butter (for espresso melt)
Speculoos / Lotus Biscoff cookie butter (for cup swirl)
cold whole milk or oat milk

steps: Warm 1 tbsp cookie butter for 10 seconds and swirl around the inside of your serving glass.
Fill the glass with ice and add 5 oz cold milk.
Place 1 tbsp cookie butter into a cup and brew the Double Espresso pod directly over it; stir immediately until the cookie butter dissolves into the hot crema.
Pour the cookie butter espresso over the iced milk and top with crushed cookie crumbs.

preparations.tested_with: Nescafé Gold Espresso Blonde or Intense
preparations.roast_note: A smooth blonde instant roast that lets the rich caramelized spiced speculoos shine through.

ingredients.item: Speculoos / Lotus Biscoff cookie butter (for espresso melt)
Speculoos / Lotus Biscoff cookie butter (for cup swirl)
cold whole milk or oat milk

steps: Warm 1 tbsp cookie butter in the microwave for 8–10 seconds and swirl inside the walls of your glass.
Fill the swirled glass with ice and pour in 6 oz cold milk.
In a small measuring cup, combine 2 tsp instant espresso and 1 tbsp cookie butter with 2 oz hot water; stir vigorously until fully melted and smooth.
Pour the warm cookie butter espresso mixture over the iced milk.
Top with crushed Biscoff cookie crumbs and stir before drinking.
